question.text: Fund GMS holds: long Indian large-cap equities INR 42.5 cr, long mid-cap INR 1 cr, SHORT USDINR and GBPINR currency futures, LONG WTI crude oil futures. Which strategy label fits BEST?

answer.text: Global-Macro Strategy with a net long bias

explanation.text: The Logic: Multi-asset (equities + FX + commodities), multi-geography exposure with mixed long/short positions is the textbook definition of Global-Macro (Section 10.1.2). Net long in risk assets => long-bias global macro. The Trap: Market-neutral requires Beta ~ 0 (not multi-asset directional bets). Merger arb is single-issuer event. Pre-IPO is private equity. Cross-Exam Context: PDF Example 10.5 nearly verbatim. XIX-C covers same.
